mapper.select: SELECT a.no AS "answer_no", a.enrollment_no AS "enrollment_no", a.question_no AS "question_no", a.user_answer AS "user_answer", a.grader_id AS "grader_id", q.title AS "title", q.answer AS "standard_answer", q.score AS "score", e.theme AS "theme", e.exam_no AS "exam_no" FROM exam_user_answer a JOIN exam_question q ON a.question_no=q.no JOIN exam_enrollment e ON a.enrollment_no=e.no WHERE a.is_correct='W' AND (a.grader_id IS NULL OR a.grader_id=#{graderId}) ORDER BY a.no
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_user_answer SET score=#{score}, is_correct=CASE WHEN #{score} > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, graded_at=SYSDATE WHERE no=#{answerNo} AND grader_id=#{graderId} AND is_correct='W'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_user_answer WHERE enrollment_no=#{enrollmentNo} AND is_correct='W'
